summary: Verified this iteration's three features (on-brand demo images, live-mode banner, live-order friendly handling) plus demo regression. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases pass, including 2 new (unsplash-jewellery images across all demo products; live order 404 friendly, no 500) and 1 spec-verification (demo order p001 qty=2 returns 201 with id ORDxxxx, total 4998, status pending; and appears in GET /orders). Frontend: DEMO home & /shop render only images.unsplash.com images (20 loaded on home, 36 loaded on /shop across 40 cards); zero picsum.photos leftovers. In DEMO no [data-testid=live-mode-banner] exists. Clicking mode-toggle-live triggers reload -> live-mode-banner appears at top with WARNING copy ('Live mode is on — no WordPress store is connected yet ...') and a live-banner-switch-demo button; clicking it returns to demo, banner disappears, and unsplash products re-render. Product detail page opens.
critical_code_review_comments: In-memory Order/User/Product stores still get polluted across test runs (a TEST_b414c5 ring from a prior admin-create test is now visible on the storefront with a broken /a.jpg image). Consider filtering TEST_-prefixed items from public listings, or namespacing admin-created demo products so regression tests don't leak into the shopfront.
LiveModeBanner copy has a small spacing bug — 'Connect your store (WORDPRESS_GRAPHQL_URL) orswitch back to Demo' — missing a space before 'switch'.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings appear on every navigation (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath). Opt-in to silence, or upgrade.
test_credentials: Admin admin@radhajewellery.com / Admin@123. Customer accounts registered per-run as TEST_<uuid>@example.com / Passw0rd!.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests continue to create a TEST_-prefixed demo product and a demo order in the in-memory store. These vanish on backend restart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Node/Express under supervisor 'nodeapi'. Data mode via X-Data-Mode header (default demo); front-end persists via localStorage 'radha_data_mode' and reloads on toggle. Live-mode banner is only rendered when mode==='live' inside StorefrontLayout. Testids in use: mode-toggle, mode-toggle-demo, mode-toggle-live, live-mode-banner, live-banner-switch-demo, cart-count, entry-overlay (auto-detaches ~2.5s). Live-mode empty catalogue and 404-on-live-order-for-demo-id are EXPECTED, not bugs. Use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression.
